description: This is a unit test class for the ClaimRequest entity within the OrangeHRM system. It verifies the proper instantiation and attribute access methods of the ClaimRequest class, including setting and getting properties like ID, employee, user, claim event, description, currency type, status, deletion flag, and dates. The test also involves mock services and fixtures setup.

classes.name: ClaimRequestTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ClaimRequest entity, ensuring its properties are correctly set and retrieved during unit tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, loads YAML data into the database, and truncates specific tables before each test.

methods.name: testEntity
methods.description: Tests the creation and attribute accessors of the ClaimRequest entity, including mocking the current date and verifying property values.
